scope: Whole sort.go and cli_test.go; main.go lines 555-660 and 775-898 only. Static review, no upstream execution or network probing.

findings.detail: parseCoreIdentity VLESS branch uses UUID alone, discarding host and port. Other protocols use protocol/host/port, discarding credentials and transport parameters. Neither is a file-content identity or a suitable exact-file deduplication key.
filterForProtocols sets seen[identity] before checkPort. A failed first candidate suppresses later candidates sharing identity. Concurrent workers choose the representative nondeterministically.
300 workers and channels of capacity 100 bound active workers and queued messages, but seen and final filtered slice grow with input.

cli_test.go contains eight top-level test functions (one table contains three invalid argument cases). Tests cover CLI errors and precedence, not identity collisions, failed-first-candidate suppression, or deterministic selection. Tests were read, not run.
sortConfigs assumes already deduplicated input; writes protocol files sequentially without atomic whole-output publication. A failed write leaves partially updated output.

decision: Reject as a file/image duplicate algorithm source; retain general lessons on identity, validation order, deterministic representatives and bounded resource accounting. No production code copied.
